name: atom-z80
description: atom: a streaming Z80 assembler that runs on a Z80

scripts.annotate:contracts: node node_modules/@jhlagado/azm/dist/src/cli.js --rc audit --contracts --nobin --nohex --nod8m --nolst asm/encoder-proof.asm && node node_modules/@jhlagado/azm/dist/src/cli.js --rc audit --contracts --nobin --nohex --nod8m --nolst asm/symbol-proof.asm && node node_modules/@jhlagado/azm/dist/src/cli.js --rc audit --contracts --nobin --nohex --nod8m --nolst asm/tokenizer-proof.asm && node node_modules/@jhlagado/azm/dist/src/cli.js --rc audit --contracts --nobin --nohex --nod8m --nolst asm/parser-proof.asm
scripts.build:dependencies: npm --prefix ../debug80/packages/azm run build && npm --prefix ../debug80/packages/debug80-runtime run build
scripts.prepare:proof: npm run generate && npm run verify:dependencies && npm run build:dependencies
